note: Toddler-friendly events near Sauvie Island, St. Johns, Portland, Vancouver and the coast, soonest first. Many holiday dates are reported but not yet confirmed, so check before going.

events.title: Howloween at the Oregon Zoo
events.detail: Last weekend of daytime costumed fun with three trick-or-treat zones, face painting, crafts and a carousel or train ride. Zoo admission plus a $5 Treat and Ride Pass, bought online in advance; billed as best for ages 2 to 10.

events.title: Sauvie Island Pumpkin Patch and corn maze
events.detail: Hayrides, farm animals and an 8-acre maze, daily 10 to 6. Kids under 6 have been free; confirm this year's prices.

events.title: Bella Organic pumpkin patch
events.detail: Free hayrides and a corn maze. Go in daytime; the night haunted maze is not recommended under 13.

events.title: Toddler and bilingual storytimes at St. Johns Library
events.detail: Toddler Storytime on Tuesdays 12:30 to 1:15 (listed Oct 27 and Nov 3), plus a bilingual Spanish-English family storytime for ages 0 to 6 on Thursdays at 10:15. Free songs, books and rhymes.

events.title: Woodstock Spooktacular
events.detail: Free, all-ages Halloween afternoon from 3 to 6 with trunk-or-treat, games and crafts. An early, low-key way to trick-or-treat with a little one.

events.title: Halloween weekend at Astoria KOA
events.detail: Pumpkin Patch Express train, pumpkin decorating, trick-or-treating and a costume parade on Saturday. Skip the evening Haunted Cove with a toddler.

events.title: Black Family Storytime
events.detail: Sunday storytime from 3:30 to 4:15 for kids from birth to age 6, first come, first served.

events.title: Sensory Sunday at Columbia River Maritime Museum
events.detail: Calm family morning from 9:30 to 11 with dimmed lights and fewer crowds, usually the first Sunday of the month. The Nov 1 date follows that pattern but isn't confirmed; regular admission applies.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Millions of lights and a light-up train, nightly from 4:30. Reported dates; the zoo hasn't confirmed them yet.

events.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square tree lighting
events.detail: Free sing-along and Santa lighting the 75-foot tree, ceremony reported for 5:30 to 6:45. Date reported by a travel guide, not yet confirmed by the Square.

events.title: Vancouver Rotary Community Tree Lighting
events.detail: Free: Santa arrives by tugboat, a lighted vehicle parade, music and carriage rides, with the tree lit around 6. Sources disagree on Nov 27 or 28, so confirm.

events.title: Christmas Festival of Lights at The Grotto
events.detail: Walk-through lights on about a quarter-mile loop; last year ran evenings 5 to 9:30. Opening date reported, not confirmed by The Grotto.

events.title: Winter Wonderland drive-through lights
events.detail: Over 250 light displays you see from the car, so a toddler can stay cozy in a car seat. Dates reported for 2026 but not yet confirmed.
